categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Jinzhong Auto Parts Manufacturing Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, development, production, and sales of automotive interior and exterior decorative parts. Its main products include wheel hub decorative parts (center caps, large-size wheel covers, inlays), automotive emblem decorative parts (badges, nameplates, steering wheel logos), body decorative parts (decorative strips, assemblies, grilles), and interior parts (instrument panel accessories, door panel accessories). The company also promotes the application of carbon fiber composite materials in automotive parts, drones, and bicycles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in mold design and manufacturing, injection molding, surface decoration processes including PVD and laser engraving, and forging of aluminum alloy wheel decorative parts. It employs advanced manufacturing execution systems (MES), ERP, and PLM for production and lifecycle management. The firm emphasizes lightweight design, aerodynamic optimization, and integration of intelligent surface treatments, with ongoing R&D in holographic projection, LED imaging for wheel caps, and carbon fiber composites.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jinzhong serves primarily OEMs and their first-tier suppliers in the automotive industry, including leading domestic and international automakers such as Tesla China, BYD, Geely, Volvo, FAW, SAIC, Volkswagen, BMW, and emerging new energy vehicle brands like NIO, Li Auto, and XPeng. The company also supplies second-tier suppliers for major automakers and has entered supply chains of North American and European automakers through its joint ventures.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Guangzhou, Qingyuan, and Nantong, and has established wholly-owned subsidiaries in the United States and Thailand. It serves domestic and overseas markets, including North America, Europe, and Asia, with exports accounting for over 40% of revenue. The company is expanding its overseas production capacity, notably with a new plant under construction in Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinzhong operates primarily as a midstream automotive parts manufacturer and supplier, producing modules and components directly for OEMs and first-tier suppliers. It is positioned as a Tier 1 and Tier 2 supplier within the automotive supply chain, focusing on high-value decorative and functional automotive parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation, focusing on lightweight materials, intelligent and energy-efficient automotive components, and advanced surface decoration technologies. It is expanding its product portfolio into carbon fiber composites and aluminum alloy forging for lightweight applications. Jinzhong is also advancing digital transformation through integrated ERP, MES, and PLM systems and is investing in new production bases domestically and internationally to support capacity growth and market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of automotive interior and exterior decorative parts and carbon fiber composite products. The company operates on a build-to-order production model, with sales contracts and framework agreements with OEMs and suppliers. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and acceptance of products, including direct sales and consignment sales models domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jinzhong is a leading player in the automotive interior and exterior decorative parts sector in China, with a strong foothold among major domestic and international OEMs. It competes with other Tier 1 automotive parts suppliers specializing in decorative and lightweight components. The company leverages its technological innovation, scale, and quality certifications to maintain a competitive edge in a market with increasing competition due to the rapid growth of new energy vehicles.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jinzhong reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.134 billion, a 22.48% increase year-over-year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 85.58 million, a slight decline of 5.83%. The company has shown steady growth in production and sales volumes, expanding capacity with new plants and investments. Total assets reached over RMB 2 billion, reflecting a 24.56% increase from the previous year, supported by ongoing capital expenditures and R&D investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinzhong emphasizes high-quality, innovative automotive decorative parts that combine aesthetic appeal with functional benefits such as noise reduction, lightweight design, and aerodynamic efficiency. Its products support the automotive industry's trends toward electrification and intelligent vehicles. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies, comprehensive quality management systems (IATF16949 certification), and close collaboration with OEMs for synchronized product development, ensuring timely delivery and customization to client specifications.
